deep.reconstruction: Context: early (pre-divided-power) stage of Grothendieck's 'crystals' talks, 1966-67. Previous page: for X/S smooth there is a comparison between de Rham cohomology H^*_DR(X/S, V) and the cohomology H^*_cris (here meaning stratifications or infinitesimal descent data, without divided powers) of a stratified module V. Without restrictions on the characteristic one only gets canonical filtered maps V -> Ω^•(V), hence a map H_cris -> H_DR. This page: (1) The isomorphism H_DR(X/S,V) ≅ H_str(X/S,V) holds when X/S is smooth and S has characteristic 0. Here H_str is the cohomology computed in the category of O_X-modules with stratification, i.e. modules over the full ring of differential operators, or equivalently infinitesimal-site cohomology. (2) He then asks what happens for X smooth projective over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p>0, with V = O_X carrying its canonical stratification. It is not clear a priori that the H^i_str are finite-dimensional, nor that they vanish for large i: 'Situation à éclaircir !'. He circles 'doute' and writes in the margin 'Ceci est sûrement faux ! (calculer les H^i_str quand X/S courbe elliptique ordinaire !)'. This indicates he expects the char-p stratified cohomology to be pathological and does not compute the de Rham cohomology. The next page confirms this: for ordinary X_0 the cohomology vanishes for i > dim X_0, although the limit of the de Rham groups is fine. (3) Remark: comparing de Rham cohomology with H_str is useful because H_str is the cohomology of a suitable 'site stratifiant', i.e. the infinitesimal site. A variant of that site is expected to give p-adic cohomology in characteristic p. This variant is what became the crystalline site with divided powers (Grothendieck's letter to Tate of 1966, IHES lectures 1966-68, Berthelot's thesis). The page records the moment when the non-PD stratified or infinitesimal theory is recognised as inadequate in char p.
errors: No real error. The tentative claim (finiteness or good behaviour of H_str in char p) is immediately flagged by Grothendieck himself as 'sûrement faux'. That is correct: in char p, stratified modules are F-divided (Katz/Gieseker), and the infinitesimal cohomology of O_X does not recover de Rham or crystalline cohomology. For an ordinary elliptic curve it captures only a Frobenius-'unit-root' type part, not the full cohomology.

deep.surprise_reason: Historically nice: it documents Grothendieck discovering that non-PD stratified cohomology fails in char p, and pointing to the ordinary elliptic curve as test case. But this story and its resolution (divided powers, Ogus's infinitesimal cohomology results) are well documented.
transcription_corrections: Line 1 probably reads roughly 'qui est vrai dans un domaine ... lorsque X/S est lisse et S de car. nulle'.
'Je doute [?] que' is likely 'Je doute fort que' (the word circled and linked to the marginal note).
'sur S opérant d'un corps' should probably read 'sur S spectre d'un corps'.
'V = O_X [?] avec stratification canonique' likely reads 'V = O_X avec sa stratification canonique'.

In the margin, '[-courbe-] {elliptique}' corresponds to the parenthesis 'p.ex. une courbe elliptique'. The marginal note reads 'Ceci est sûrement faux ! (calculer les H^i_str quand X/S courbe elliptique ordinaire !)'.
'la cohomologie [?] [-au sens-] H_str' is probably 'la cohomologie au sens des stratifications H_str'.
